title: [finding] client: `envelope-caller-census.test.ts` walks `.cache/`, so `pnpm test` goes red on `main` right after the documented `pnpm objectui:build` — the objectui checkout it leaves behind is counted as a 29th SDK call site
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing spot and a reproduction (`finding` class (a): a documented command sequence on an untouched `main` fails a required test).
reach: public entry measured once — `pnpm test` on a fresh clone after `pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm objectui:build` ends `Failed: @objectstack/client#test` (3 of 652 tests), every other package green.
Reader: `domain:cli` seat (`packages/client/src/envelope-caller-census.test.ts`, `SKIP_DIRS` at line 166); optionally `scripts/build-console.sh` for where the clone lands.
Dedup: `search_issues` "envelope-caller-census test fails after pnpm objectui:build .cache/objectui checkout counted as call site pnpm test red" (open + closed) → 0 cards.
Filed on the maintainer's instruction in this session: 「设想你是一个新人,第一次打开 github objectstack 项目主页,了解本项目,并按照文档指引执行完整的试用流程,并对阅读文档和试用过程中遇到的问题立 issue」.

## Summary

A newcomer following the docs in order — README "Hack on the framework" (`pnpm install`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm dev`, `pnpm test`) and `content/docs/getting-started/examples.mdx` (`pnpm objectui:build` to get the Console) — ends with a red `pnpm test` on an untouched `main`:

```text
@objectstack/client:test:  FAIL  src/envelope-caller-census.test.ts > #13079 §3 — every call site is classified > ⭐ THE NUMBER, post-convergence: ZERO call sites still read the envelope, and none is production code
- Expected
+ Received
- []
+ [
+   {
+     "file": ".cache/objectui-a58626c88dc8/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts",
+     "line": 6347,
+     "method": "analytics.query",
+     "receiver": "sdk",
+   },
+ ]
…
 FAIL  … > records the split: 18 payload pins, 10 result-insensitive, 11 not-SDK
- 28
+ 29
 Test Files  1 failed | 50 passed (51)
      Tests  3 failed | 649 passed (652)
Failed:    @objectstack/client#test
```

`scripts/build-console.sh` (what `pnpm objectui:build` runs) shallow-clones objectui into `.cache/objectui-<sha>/` when there is no `../objectui` sibling — the normal case on a fresh machine. The census test's walker starts at the repo root and skips only

```ts
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
    'node_modules', 'dist', 'build', 'coverage', '.git', '.next', '.turbo', 'out',
]);
```

so the whole objectui source tree under `.cache/` is scanned as if it were this repository's code, and its one `sdk.analytics.query(...)` call moves the pinned count from 28 to 29 and fails three assertions. The test's own failure note is misleading in this case: it says "the delta is a real call", which is true, but the call is in another repository's checkout.

AGENTS.md already records `.cache/objectui-*` as a stale-artifact hazard for `pnpm lint` ("a full objectui checkout left by `build-console.sh`, linted as if it were ours") and prescribes `rm -rf .cache` after the console build. This card is the `pnpm test` half of the same hazard: nothing in the README or the examples page says to delete `.cache/` before testing, and the gate that reds is a count pin whose message blames a real call site.

## Reproduction

Fresh clone of `main`, Node v22.22.0, pnpm 10.31.0, no `../objectui` checkout.

```bash
pnpm install && pnpm build          # exit 0
pnpm objectui:build                 # clones objectui@a58626c88dc8 into .cache/, ~10 min, exit 0
pnpm test                           # 131 successful, 135 total; Failed: @objectstack/client#test
```

The three failing assertions and their diffs are the ones quoted above; every other package passed. The only counted site outside this repository's packages is the one under `.cache/`.

## Expected

`pnpm test` on an untouched `main` passes after the documented Console build. A repo-walking pin should not read a gitignored cache directory as source.

## Actual

`pnpm test` is red until the reader guesses `rm -rf .cache`, which no on-ramp document mentions.

## Suggested direction

- Add `.cache` (and probably `.objectstack`, `.playwright-mcp`) to `SKIP_DIRS` in `envelope-caller-census.test.ts`; `walk()` is the single entry point, so it is a one-line change, and the ledger sums it compares against do not move.
- Consider the same skip in the other repo-walking tests (`packages/spec/src/**/*-retirement.test.ts`, `packages/metadata-fs/test/watch-dot-root.test.ts` already know about `.cache` — a shared skip list would keep the walkers in step).
- Have `scripts/build-console.sh` print the `rm -rf .cache` advice, or clone outside the repo root (e.g. under `$TMPDIR`), so the hazard stops existing instead of being documented.
